_note: All meditation content lives here so a future native app can reuse it unchanged. dow: 0=Sun..6=Sat. 'say' holds every spoken line for a day; 'common' holds lines shared by all days. Each line becomes one recording (audio/<day>-<key>.mp3 or audio/common-<key>.mp3). breath.pattern: [phase, seconds, cue] where phase is in | out | hold | holdout | pump | free, and cue is a 'say'/'common' key (in and out rotate through in_a..c / out_a..c). breath.lines: [seconds into the step, key] for spoken reminders when there is no pattern. Spoken cues stop guideSeconds before the breath step ends, when 'on_your_own' plays. checkins: seconds into the meditation when checkin_1 and checkin_2 play.

common.settle: Put the phone down... it will survive without you. Now... settle.
common.arrive: Sit tall... Soften the jaw... and the shoulders.
common.hold_q: Don't answer it. Just... hold it lightly. That is your intention.
common.on_your_own: Now... continue on your own. I will be quiet. Mostly.
common.complete: Well done... Carry the seal with you.
common.test: This is how I will sound... during your sit. Not bad, yes?

days.release: Aang surrenders his fears of harm and danger. The ground is still there.

breath.name: Box breath
breath.read: In for 4, hold for 4, out for 4, hold empty for 4, through the nose.

days.pool: Attention at the base of the spine where you meet the cushion. Picture a pool there, clouded with worry. On every exhale, silently say LAM and feel the cloud settle into the earth.
days.ask: What am I afraid of right now? And what would I do if I trusted the ground beneath me?
days.seal: Let one thing you do today come from trust, not fear.
days.teach: Monday theme: grounding before ambition. Cue students to feel three points of contact before any effort.

say.today: Today... the Earth pool, at the base of the spine. It is blocked... by fear. Fear is very good at predicting the future... and very bad at being right.
say.intro: Box breath. In for four... hold... out for four... and hold, empty.
say.pool: Rest at the base of the spine... On each exhale... silently... lam.
say.ask: What am I afraid of... right now? ... And what would I do... if I trusted the ground beneath me?
say.checkin_1: Notice your breath... Is it still slow? Good. Feel the weight of your body... sinking into the earth.
say.checkin_2: Come back to the breath... Remember your question. The ground is still holding you. It has not let go once.
say.seal: Let one thing you do today... come from trust, not fear.

days.release: Aang forgives himself for running away and for the hurt it caused.

breath.name: Nadi Shodana
breath.read: Alternate nostrils. Start by inhaling left, exhaling right. Then inhale on the side you just exhaled from, and switch. In for 4, out for 6.

days.pool: Attention in the low belly and sacrum. Picture water there, slow and muddy with old regret. With each exhale, silently say VAM and let the water move and clear.
days.ask: What am I still carrying that I could forgive? What would I keep if I let the rest flow away?
days.seal: Enjoy one simple thing today without earning it first.
days.teach: Tuesday theme: fluid hips and forgiveness. Pair with Goddess and slow hip circles.

say.today: Today... the Water pool, in the low belly. It is blocked... by guilt. Guilt is a teacher... who forgets to dismiss the class.
say.intro: Alternate nostrils... Close the right with your thumb... and we begin on the left.
say.pool: Rest in the low belly... On each exhale... silently... vam.
say.ask: What am I still carrying... that I could forgive? ... What would I keep... if I let the rest flow away?
say.checkin_1: Check the breath... soft, and even. Picture water in the low belly... moving again... clearing a little more.
say.checkin_2: Back to the breath... Remember your question. Water does not apologize for flowing. Neither must you.
say.seal: Enjoy one simple thing today... without earning it first.

days.release: Aang accepts his role as a firebender despite his past mistakes.

breath.name: Kapalabhati
breath.read: One round of about one minute. Pump: short, sharp belly exhales while the soft ticks play (about 30 seconds). Then a full inhale, hold with the bandhas, release slowly, breathe naturally. Lying down? Slow belly breaths instead.

days.pool: Attention at the stomach, just under the ribs. Picture a fire there, smothered by old embarrassment. With each exhale, silently say RAM and let the flame stand up straight.
days.ask: Where am I holding back because of an old mistake? What would I do if it no longer defined me?
days.seal: Do one brave thing today, before you have time to talk yourself out of it.
days.teach: Wednesday theme: no shortcuts. Core work and holds; cue effort without force.

say.today: Today... the Fire pool, under the ribs. It is blocked... by shame. Every master has burned the rice... many times. That is how they became masters.
say.intro: Kapalabhati... Sharp exhales from the belly... with the ticks.
say.pool: Rest under the ribs... On each exhale... silently... ram.
say.ask: Where am I holding back... because of an old mistake? ... What would I do... if it no longer defined me?
say.checkin_1: Notice the breath... let it be easy now. Picture a small flame under the ribs... steady... not trying to impress anyone.
say.checkin_2: Return to the breath... Remember your question. The flame does not ask permission... to be warm.
say.seal: Do one brave thing today... before you have time to talk yourself out of it.

days.release: Love is energy. It stays in the heart and is reborn in new forms.

breath.name: Long, deep breathing
breath.read: Slow Ujjayi through the nose. Fill belly, ribs, then chest for 5. Empty in reverse for 7.

days.pool: Attention in the center of the chest. Picture clear air there, heavy with something you lost. With each exhale, silently say YAM and let the air move freely again.
days.ask: What loss am I still carrying? Where has that love already found a new home?
days.seal: Show up fully for one person today, including yourself.
days.teach: Thursday theme: open chest, open heart. Backbends with long exhales.

say.today: Today... the Air pool, at the heart. It is blocked... by grief. Love does not leave, you know... it only changes address.
say.intro: Long, deep breaths... Fill the belly... the ribs... the chest... and empty slowly.
say.pool: Rest at the heart... On each exhale... silently... yam.
say.ask: What loss am I still carrying? ... Where has that love... already found a new home?
say.checkin_1: Check the breath... full, and gentle. Picture clear air moving through the center of the chest... nothing stuck... nothing held.
say.checkin_2: Back to the breath... Remember your question. The heart is very big. There is room in it... for everything.
say.seal: Show up fully for one person today... including yourself.

days.release: Aang stops lying to himself and accepts who he is.

breath.name: Long exhale
breath.read: In for 4. Out for 8 through a soft Ujjayi, letting a silent HAM ride the whole exhale.

days.pool: Attention at the throat. Picture a narrow stream there, jammed by things left unsaid. With each exhale, silently say HAM and feel the channel widen.
days.ask: Where am I not being honest with myself? What do I already know that I haven't said?
days.seal: Say one true thing today that you have been holding back.
days.teach: Friday theme: Satya. Cue students to notice where they perform a pose versus feel it.

say.today: Today... the Sound pool, at the throat. It is blocked... by lies. And the hardest lies to spot... are the ones we tell ourselves. We are very convincing.
say.intro: Long exhale... In for four... and out for eight.
say.pool: Rest at the throat... On each exhale... silently... ham.
say.ask: Where am I not being honest... with myself? ... What do I already know... that I haven't said?
say.checkin_1: Notice the breath... the long, quiet exhale. Picture the throat opening... like a stream... finding its way.
say.checkin_2: Return to the breath... Remember your question. The truth is patient. It will wait... but not forever.
say.seal: Say one true thing today... that you have been holding back.

days.release: All four elements, and all people, are connected as one.

breath.name: Sama Vritti
breath.read: Equal breath: in for 5, out for 5, through the nose. Eyes closed, gaze softly up toward the brow.

days.pool: Attention between the eyebrows. Picture a still pool of light there, fogged by the stories you tell about yourself and others. With each exhale, silently say OM and let the fog lift.
days.ask: Where am I seeing separation that isn't really there?
days.seal: Notice one thread today that connects you to someone else.
days.teach: Saturday theme: third eye and balance poses. Drishti as a teaching tool.

say.today: Today... the Light pool, between the eyebrows. It is blocked... by illusion. We think we are separate... like waves who have not yet heard about the ocean.
say.intro: Equal breath... In for five... and out for five.
say.pool: Rest between the eyebrows... On each exhale... silently... om.
say.ask: Where am I seeing separation... that isn't really there?
say.checkin_1: Check the breath... equal, and easy. Picture a still pool of light behind the eyes... the fog lifting... a little more.
say.checkin_2: Back to the breath... Remember your question. Everything is connected... even that itch on your nose... to the rest of you.
say.seal: Today... notice one thread... that connects you to someone else.

days.release: To open the last pool, Aang has to let go. He chose to hold on. Notice what you choose.

breath.name: Counting breath
breath.read: Natural breath, no control and no tones. Count each exhale from 1 to 10, then start again. Lose count? Back to 1, no judgment.

days.pool: Attention at the crown of the head. Picture an opening there, a stream that rises upward, blocked by everything you're gripping. No sound today. Let each exhale loosen your hold.
days.ask: What am I gripping that I don't need right now? What would it feel like to put it down?
days.seal: Choose one thing you will not carry into the week ahead.
days.teach: Sunday theme: Aparigraha. Long Savasana; cue letting the floor take the weight.

say.today: Today... the last pool, Thought, at the crown. It is blocked... by attachment. Hold anything too tightly... and even a feather becomes heavy.
say.intro: Natural breath... Count each exhale... one to ten... then begin again.
say.count_lost: Lost count? ... Begin again at one. Everybody loses count. Even me.
say.pool: Rest at the crown... No sound today... just let each exhale... loosen your hold.
say.ask: What am I gripping... that I don't need right now? ... What would it feel like... to put it down?
say.checkin_1: Notice the breath... no counting now, just breathing. Picture an opening at the crown... and let one thought float out... like smoke.
say.checkin_2: Return to the breath... Remember your question. Open the hand. What is meant for you... will not fall out.
say.seal: Choose one thing... you will not carry into the week ahead.
